name: diff-leppard
description: Diff Leppard: AI code review of uncommitted changes or GitHub pull requests using your own self-hosted LLM (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, or any OpenAI-compatible server). VS Code extension, CLI, gh extension and GitHub Action.

enumDescriptions: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server: vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp server, LocalAI, TGI, SGLang, Ollama's /v1 endpoint, etc.
Ollama's native /api/chat endpoint (lets the extension set num_ctx so long diffs are not silently truncated).
diffLeppard.provider.description: Which API style to use when talking to your model server.

diffLeppard.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL of the model server.

- vLLM: `http://host:8000/v1`
- Ollama (openai provider): `http://host:11434/v1`
- Ollama (ollama provider): `http://host:11434`
- LM Studio: `http://host:1234/v1`
- llama.cpp: `http://host:8080/v1`

diffLeppard.model.markdownDescription: Model name as the server knows it (e.g. `Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct` or `qwen2.5-coder:14b`). Leave empty to pick from the server's model list. Use **Diff Leppard: Select Model** to choose one.

diffLeppard.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Low values give more consistent reviews.

diffLeppard.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may generate per request (max_tokens / num_predict).

enumDescriptions: Send response_format {type: json_object} (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp). Ollama native: format "json".
Send the full JSON schema for guided/structured decoding (vLLM, newer Ollama, LM Studio). Most reliable when supported.
Don't request structured output; just parse JSON out of the reply.
diffLeppard.jsonMode.description: How to ask the server for structured JSON output. If the server rejects it, the extension falls back to 'none' automatically.

diffLeppard.stream.description: Stream responses. Recommended: avoids Node's 5-minute header timeout on slow models and shows progress.

diffLeppard.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Abort a single model request after this many seconds.

diffLeppard.concurrency.description: How many diff chunks to send to the server at once. vLLM batches well, so 2-4 is fine there; keep 1 for Ollama on a single GPU.

diffLeppard.ollamaNumCtx.description: Context window (num_ctx) to request when provider is 'ollama'. Ollama's default is small and silently truncates prompts.

diffLeppard.extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers to send to the model server (e.g. for a reverse proxy). The API key itself is stored securely via 'Diff Leppard: Set LLM API Key'.

diffLeppard.extraBody.markdownDescription:
Extra fields merged into every chat request body. Examples:

- Turn off thinking on Qwen3-style models in vLLM/SGLang (much faster reviews): `{"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": false}}`
- Ollama: `{"think": false}` or `{"options": {"top_k": 20}}`
- Sampling extras: `{"top_p": 0.9, "top_k": 20}`

diffLeppard.maxChunkChars.markdownDescription: Diffs are split into chunks of at most this many characters per request (roughly 3.5 chars per token). Size it to your model's context window minus `maxOutputTokens` and ~1k tokens of prompt: e.g. 24000 for a 16k-context model, 90000 for 32k.

diffLeppard.contextLines.description: Lines of unchanged context around each change in local diffs (git diff -U).

diffLeppard.includeUntracked.description: Include new, untracked (but not ignored) files when reviewing uncommitted changes.

diffLeppard.excludeGlobs.description: Files matching these globs are not sent to the model. Patterns without a '/' match the file name in any directory.

diffLeppard.extraInstructions.description: Extra instructions appended to the review prompt (e.g. 'This is a WordPress plugin; flag missing escaping and nonce checks').

diffLeppard.instructionsFile.description: Repo-relative path of a file with project-specific review guidelines. Read from the working tree for local reviews and from the PR's base branch for PR reviews. Leave empty to disable.

diffLeppard.showStatusBar.description: Show a 'Review' button in the status bar.

diffLeppard.github.apiUrl.markdownDescription: GitHub REST API URL. For GitHub Enterprise Server use `https://your-host/api/v3` (and set `github-enterprise.uri` so VS Code can sign you in).

enumDescriptions: Use VS Code's built-in GitHub sign-in.
Use the token from the GitHub CLI (`gh auth token`). Useful when an org blocks VS Code's OAuth app.
diffLeppard.github.auth.description: Where to get a GitHub token from.

enumDescriptions: After a PR review finishes, ask whether to post it (as a submitted or a pending/draft review).
Post automatically when the review finishes.
Never post automatically; use 'Post Last Review to GitHub' manually.
diffLeppard.github.postReview.description: Whether to post PR review findings back to GitHub.

enumDescriptions: Submit as a plain comment review.
Request changes when there is a critical or major finding, otherwise comment.
Create a pending (draft) review that you edit and submit yourself on GitHub.
diffLeppard.github.reviewEvent.description: Review type used when posting automatically or via 'Post review'.

diffLeppard.github.suggestionBlocks.description: Render the model's proposed code as GitHub ```suggestion blocks (one-click apply). Off by default because local models often get the exact line range slightly wrong.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --out diff-leppard.vsix
